jsonld.description: Stepping into the lobby of the Courtyard Columbus Airport will now be more of an experience rather than an exchange, with inviting seating arrangements and innovative touches for a more personalized encounter. The lobby is home to The Bistro which offers menu items to satisfy even the most critical of eaters. Offerings range from Starbucks coffee, made-to-order eggs and parfaits, evening cocktails, and soups, salads and sandwiches for dinner. A 24-hour business center is adjacent to the lobby, featuring computers and free printing, faxing and copying services, as well as a boarding pass printing station to help avoid long lines at the airport. Fitness fanatics are welcome to use the newly remodeled fitness center featuring modern cardiovascular equipment and free weights.

hasMemberProgram.description: Courtyard by Marriott Columbus Airport participates in Marriott Bonvoy, a hotel loyalty program that lets members earn points and redeem them for travel and experiences across participating hotels and partners. When staying at Courtyard by Marriott Columbus Airport, Marriott Bonvoy members can earn points on eligible stays and use points toward future travel, including hotel nights and other redemption options available through the program. Members also enjoy access to exclusive benefits and flexible redemption options designed to help them get more value from every stay.
